title: What Would Help Students Most?
instructions: Families and staff put these forward at the start of the year, and the district can take on only a few. Choose the ones you think would make the biggest difference to students and put them in priority order, most important first. Then add one idea of your own that nobody proposed.
options: later start times for high school
smaller class sizes in the early grades
music, art and shop back on the timetable
after-school tutoring that is actually free
